title: Senior Analyst : SAP SD Pricing
description:
**Job Summary**

Responsible for collaborating with business partners and identifying business problems. Recommend solutions with new or existing processes, applications, systems, programs, or software. Will manage and drive multiple primary assignments and handle complex issues/requests. Will act as the primary contact as a business relationship manager that will become a subject matter expert in operations data for Safety, People, Quality, Service, or Cost.
**Job Description**

**About Medline:**
==================

Medline India was setup in 2010 in Pune, primarily as an offshore Development center and to augment resources for Medline Industries LP headquartered in Chicago, USA. We are a 1300\+ strong and growing team of technology, finance \& and business support professionals who support our businesses worldwide towards a mission to make healthcare run better. Medline India is proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work by the Great Place to Work Institute® (India) for the duration May 2023 – May 2024\.
 

We are an organization with a conducive work environment, ample opportunities to learn, contribute and grow with a highly empowered \& engaged team. We encourage our people to share their best ideas and create new opportunities for our customers and ourselves to work together in order to solve today’s toughest healthcare challenges. These are testimonies to Medline been consistently ranked as **Best Employers in multiple categories by Forbes** for the last couple of years. We have also been listed at **\#16 place on Fortune 500** list with $20 Billion sales last year. At Medline India \#PeopleMatter.


Medline Industries is a healthcare company–a manufacturer, distributor and so much more, doing business in more than 125 countries and territories around the world. We provide the quality medical products and solutions our customers need to deliver their best care to every person in every care setting. Together, we free up the clinical and supply chain resources required to improve the overall operating performance of healthcare.  



  

Medline Industries has an exciting position for an experienced IT **Senior Analyst – SAP SD Pricing** . The Senior Analyst will work with the business, functional, and technical teams to define, document, design, implement and support SAP ECC \& Vistex based solutions that meet business objectives.


**Location: Pune**

**Required skills:**

* 6\-12 years of experience in **SAP SD Pricing** area including all ECC versions and S4 HANA.
* Should have thorough understanding of all the components in Order to Cash processes
* Expertise in SAP Pricing configuration and enhancement of complex pricing scenarios.
* Strong hands\-on SAP SD configuration experience related to master data, order processing, pricing, output, billing, and experience in integration with other systems and modules especially FICO \& BI.
* Should have worked on multiple enhancements \& customizations right from requirements gathering to Production deployment
* Should have worked on at least one End\-to\-End implementation project
* Proven ability to research, assess and implement SAP solutions to support new business requirements
* Excellent communication \& collaboration skills, and ability to translate business processes or concepts into technical requirements
* Ability to work under pressure to meet deadlines and be able to multitask and prioritize as needed.
* Excellent data analysis and analytical skills along with the ability to debug and trouble\-shoot issues.
* Enthusiastic outlook with affinity to quickly learn new things.
* Team player with effective coordination with other employees.
* The ability to successfully interact with on\-site business \& team members and work in a matrix environment is required

**Educational Qualification**  



BE, B TECH or MBA with major in Sales/Marketing from a premier institute.  

* 

  

**Desired Skills:**

* Implementation at a large distributor/manufacturer. Pharma/Healthcare distribution experience is preferred.
* Experience in Vistex module
* Ability to understand ABAP code and be conversant in debugging.

**Responsibilities:**

* As part of the Rebates \& Pricing team, lead various initiatives and be responsible for maintenance and enhancement of IS Applications supporting Pricing, Rebates, Order to Cash and related business functions
* Build relationships, network and work closely with business users and business leadership to define business processes, roadmaps, priorities and execute projects in SAP/Vistex to achieve business goals.
* Learn and gain expertise in Medline business processes, map out process flows, and identify areas for improvement with process change or system improvements.
* Work closely with the business community to elicit and define requirements, business goals and critical success factors with the goal of delivering the correct solution per business\-mandated deadlines.
* Own delivery of a project and drive the project to closure with little or no supervision and follow\-ups from business or IS supervisors.
* Collaborate with various technical and functional teams to evaluate \& propose design alternatives and optimize the solution, while minimizing impact to system stability and performance.
* Present ideas, designs and areas of expertise to broader groups, including management in the user community
* Communicate system issues and impacts to business stakeholders in clear non\-technical terms.
* Document detailed requirements, solution design and test plans using standard templates as part of Medline’s SDLC and Agile Methodology.
* Carry out functional testing and assist with the QA review process for Change Approvals.
* Assist the team manager in determining the scope and impact of enhancement requests, estimating effort, developing detailed project plans, managing cutover tasks and communicating status as required.
* Assist the team manager in status reporting and project milestone tracking.
* Effectively plan, create documentation and conduct transition activities for newly implemented functionality to teammates and business users.
* Demonstrate a “Get it Done” attitude and drive initiatives to closure with proactive stakeholder interaction and following\-ups and escalating as needed.
* Actively participate in monitoring, maintaining, supporting and enhancing our OTC System Landscape including but not limited to SAP ECC, Vistex, and other Tools.
* Ensure the highest level of systems availability, and provide off\-hours support as needed including, but not limited to, participating in the on\-call rotation.
* Maintain a calm and professional demeanor at all times and consistently interact professionally and productively with all levels of Medline employees.
Follow Medline’s Code of Ethics and other corporate policies.  
* 

  

Click here to learn more about a career in IT at Medline!


Our benefit package includes health insurance, life and disability, 401(k) contributions, paid time off, etc., for employees working 30 or more hours per week on average. For roles where employees work less than 30 hours per week, benefits include 401(k) contributions as well as access to the Employee Assistance Program, Employee Resource Groups and the Employee Service Corp.

title: Training Consultant
description:
**Training Consultant, Onsite, Pune**

  

**POSITION\-SPECIFIC OVERVIEW**

This position delivers the curriculum designed by the Training Manager to new and existing associates across front\-end, mid\-cycle, and back\-end RCM functions. Acting as the primary point of contact for learners during onboarding, nesting, and refresher training, the Trainer translates policies, payer rules, and system workflows into engaging, easy\-to\-follow instruction, and closely tracks each trainee's progress toward production readiness. This is a hands\-on, floor\-facing role that blends classroom facilitation, on\-the\-job coaching, and performance feedback to ensure every associate reaches proficiency quickly and sustains it once in production.  



  

**CORE RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Assess learning and performance needs by partnering with business leaders, clients, subject matter experts, and stakeholders to identify knowledge gaps and training requirements.
* Design, develop, and maintain training programs, curricula, learning materials, job aids, and performance support resources that support role effectiveness and business objectives.
* Deliver instructor\-led, virtual, and self\-paced training programs to employees, clients, and end users on products, processes, workflows, services, and organizational initiatives.
* Translate technical, operational, and business concepts into engaging, audience\-appropriate learning experiences that promote understanding and skill development.
* Support implementation, activation, and change initiatives by developing and delivering training that enables successful adoption of new solutions, technologies, processes, and operational practices.
* Facilitate onboarding, knowledge transfer, and readiness activities to accelerate learner proficiency and support successful transitions.
* Evaluate training effectiveness through assessments, participant feedback, performance metrics, and stakeholder input, and implement continuous improvements to learning programs.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure training content remains accurate, current, aligned with product enhancements, operational requirements, and organizational priorities.
* Provide coaching, consultation, and ongoing learning support to reinforce knowledge application and improve individual and team performance.
* Maintain training records, learning content repositories, and instructional documentation in accordance with established standards and processes.
* Monitor industry trends, adult learning methodologies, and emerging training technologies to enhance learning effectiveness and user engagement.
Contribute to the development of learning strategies and best practices that support workforce readiness, operational consistency, customer success, and business performance.  
* 

  

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Education, Instructional Design, Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Healthcare Information Technology, Communications, Organizational Development, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* 2\-4 years’ experience designing, developing, and delivering training programs, learning solutions, or instructional content.
* Knowledge of adult learning principles, instructional design methodologies, and learning facilitation techniques.
* Experience creating training materials, including presentations, job aids, guides, e\-learning content, and performance support resources.
* Strong verbal, written, presentation, and facilitation skills.
* Ability to communicate complex business, operational, or technical information to diverse audiences.
* Experience collaborating with cross\-functional teams, stakeholders, and subject matter experts.
* Ability to assess training needs and develop solutions that address knowledge and performance gaps.
* Strong organizational, planning, and project management skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and learning technologies used to develop and deliver training.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt to changing business needs.  
* 

  

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience in healthcare, healthcare technology, software, SaaS, revenue cycle management, clinical operations, or related industries.
* Experience supporting software implementations, system deployments, business process changes, or organizational transformation initiatives.
* Knowledge of healthcare workflows, regulatory requirements, reimbursement processes, medical coding, or healthcare operations.
* Experience with instructional design frameworks such as ADDIE, SAM, or similar methodologies.
* Experience developing e\-learning content using learning authoring tools.
* Experience with learning management systems (LMS) and learning analytics.
* Experience facilitating virtual instructor\-led training and large\-scale training programs.
* Change management, organizational effectiveness, or user adoption experience.
* Experience consulting directly with clients or customer\-facing stakeholders.
Professional certifications related to training, learning, instructional design, project management, or change management.  
* 

  

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS/WORKING CONDITIONS**

Primarily works in a standard office environment. Sit/Stand at a desk working consistently on a computer. Frequently talking, hearing, seeing, and heavy use of a keyboard and mouse. May require working after hours.  



  

Job Location: Pune, India office.
  

Working Arrangements: 5 days/Week, US Work Hours (7:30pm to 4:30am IST)

Veradigm believes in empowering our associates with the tools and flexibility to bring the best version of themselves to work. Through our generous benefits package with an emphasis on work/life balance, we give our employees the opportunity to allow their careers to flourish.


* Quarterly Company\-Wide Recharge Days

title: MicroFocus Analyst
description:
Date live: 09/22/2026


Business Area: GTIS


Area of Expertise: Technology


Contract: Permanent


Reference Code: JR\-0000107802


  
Join us as a MicroFocus Analyst at Barclays, where you'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You'll harness cutting\-edge technology to revolutionise our digital offerings, ensuring unapparelled customer experiences.
  

  

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as experience with, skills to meet business requirement as well as job\-specific skillsets.

  

  

To be successful as a MicroFocus Analyst, you should have experience with:

  

  

**Essential Skills:**

  

  

* Familiar with vendor technologies – Micro Focus\\Rocket Enterprise suites, Verastream, Reflection, Windows, OpenText, Mainframe.
* Hands on experience in Windows system administration and scripting knowledge.
* Hands on experience supporting a Windows based production and development infrastructure.
* Hands on experience in automation tools and java expertise.
* Experience in supporting applications in the Cloud environment.
* Prepared to work directly with users troubleshooting connectivity issues via email, chat, or ticketing system
* Provide continuous monitoring and maintenance of applications and infrastructures to ensure critical host\-based and core business applications remain accessible, secure, and fully integrated with modern platforms
* Able to communicate effectively with users from different countries and management levels
* Demonstrate expertise in problem solving such as writing code or scripts to scale down reported problems into discrete components that replicate issues.
* Experience with working with vendors.
* Possess high level analytic skills to review logs, dumps and traces to determine if reported issues are user error, expected behaviour or bugs.
* Experience supporting 24x7 HA production environment.
* Provide Weekend/On\-Call work for repetitive tasks such as patching, server reboots, certificate renewals, supporting software upgrades (MQ, Autosys, DB2 Client), DCR tests

**Some other highly valued skills may include below:**

  

  

* Work on Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management (IPC)
* Willing to learn COBOL, CICS and SQL programming languages.

This role is based out of Pune.  

  



**Purpose of the role**


To build and maintain infrastructure platforms and products that support applications and data systems, using hardware, software, networks, and cloud computing platforms as required with the aim of ensuring that the infrastructure is reliable, scalable, and secure. Ensure the reliability, availability, and scalability of the systems, platforms, and technology through the application of software engineering techniques, automation, and best practices in incident response.


**Accountabilities**


* Build Engineering: Development, delivery, and maintenance of high\-quality infrastructure solutions to fulfil business requirements ensuring measurable reliability, performance, availability, and ease of use. Including the identification of the appropriate technologies and solutions to meet business, optimisation, and resourcing requirements.
* Incident Management: Monitoring of IT infrastructure and system performance to measure, identify, address, and resolve any potential issues, vulnerabilities, or outages. Use of data to drive down mean time to resolution.
* Automation: Development and implementation of automated tasks and processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual intervention, utilising software scripting/coding disciplines.
* Security: Implementation of a secure configuration and measures to protect infrastructure against cyber\-attacks, vulnerabilities, and other security threats, including protection of hardware, software, and data from unauthorised access.
* Teamwork: Cross\-functional collaboration with product managers, architects, and other engineers to define IT Infrastructure requirements, devise solutions, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives via a data driven approach.
* Learning: Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations, and actively contribute to the organization's technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**


* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Manager, Digital Systems
description:
**Job Title:\-** Manager, Digital Systems


Req:R0097261

Location: Pune (Koregaon Park), India.


Full\-time/Part\-time: Full\-time


**Company Overview:**

Sandvik’s Intelligent Manufacturing is on an exciting growth journey, building the new digital era of manufacturing. Our digital manufacturing solutions automate and connect the component manufacturing value chain – from design and planning to preparation, production and verification. Our objective is to make the shift towards efficient and sustainable manufacturing. As the market leader in CAM and metrology software, with a global footprint and over 400,000 software licenses, we have a unique foundation to build on . Please read more about us here .


At Mastercam, we do not just keep pace with manufacturing—we set the pace. For over 40 years, we have been the name behind the breakthroughs, the partner for those who refuse to settle. When the industry says “too complex,” we say, “challenge accepted.”


We are more than software. We are a movement of makers, innovators, and problem\-solvers driving transformation across the globe.


Backed by a network of 400 Channel Partners and a thriving developer community, Mastercam delivers the tools and expertise to turn ambitious ideas into flawless reality. From aerospace to automotive, medical to education, we empower manufacturers to push boundaries and redefine what is possible.


As part of Intelligent Manufacturing and the Sandvik Group, we are leading the charge in digital transformation. Our team of 500\+ professionals is united by a single mission: to help achieve precision, productivity, and performance without compromise.


**Our Core Values? They are not just words. They are how we win:**

* **Winning Together:** Collaboration is not optional—it is the engine that drives us.
* **Curiosity:** We question, we explore, we innovate. Every day.
* **Responsibility:** Safety, integrity, and sustainability aren’t boxes to check—they are the foundation of trust.
* **Customer\-Focused:** We listen. We adapt. We deliver. Always.

Innovation. Collaboration. Growth. That is the Mastercam way. Explore more at www.mastercam.com , connect on LinkedIn , and join the conversation with \#mastercam.


The next big challenge is waiting—are you ready to accept?


**Position Overview:**

Mastercam seeks a Manager of Digital Systems in India who is responsible for the day\-to\-day leadership, coordination, staffing, and development of Digital Systems resources located in India.


The Manager, Digital Systems supports Digital Enablement, Digital Experience, and Digital Integrations teams, serving as the primary local people leader while partnering closely with global functional leaders to ensure successful delivery of business and technology initiatives.


**Key Responsibilities:**

**Leadership \& People Management**

* Lead, coach, mentor, and develop Digital Systems team members across multiple disciplines, including business systems, customer\-facing digital platforms, and enterprise integrations.
* Establish clear performance expectations, goals, and career development plans.
* Conduct regular one\-on\-one meetings, performance evaluations, and development discussions.
* Support recruiting, onboarding, succession planning, and workforce development efforts.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, continuous learning, and operational excellence.
* Serve as the primary local manager for India\-based Digital Systems team members.

**Delivery \& Portfolio Management**

* Partner with Product Owners, Architects, and Digital Systems leaders to align resources against strategic priorities.
* Coordinate project delivery, sprint execution, resource allocation, capacity planning, and production support activities.
* Monitor delivery metrics, team workload, and project health to proactively identify risks and remove obstacles.
* Ensure enhancement requests, defects, incidents, and technical debt are appropriately prioritized and addressed.
* Contribute to roadmap planning and execution across the broader Digital Systems organization.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Facilitate communication between India\-based teams and global leadership.
* Ensure alignment between business objectives and technical execution.
* Help establish consistent development, integration, and support practices across all Digital Systems teams.

**Requirements** :


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Salesforce, MuleSoft, Agile, Scrum, or related certifications a plus.
* 7\+ years of experience in software development, enterprise systems, digital platforms, integrations, or related technology disciplines.
* 3\+ years of experience leading, mentoring, or managing technical teams.
* Experience working with Agile development methodologies and software delivery processes.
* Experience supporting enterprise business systems, customer\-facing digital platforms, or integration technologies.
* Demonstrated success managing both project delivery and production support responsibilities.
* Strong communication, leadership, stakeholder management, and organizational skills.
* Proven ability to lead teams across multiple technology domains and business functions.
* Experience leveraging AI\-enabled tools or automation to improve productivity and operational effectiveness, or a demonstrated ability to rapidly learn, evaluate, and apply such technologies at scale.

**Key Competencies**

* Above average communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to provide accurate and timely information in a succinct and easy to understand manner.
* Proven time management skills and a track record of working in a team environment successfully supporting others.
* Well\-organized, attention to detail and able to multi\-task.
* Problem solving and analysis skills.

This role will focus on integrating an acquired company (to be acquired) to Mastercam per Sandvik's and Mastercam's program and processes \- from a compliance and financial controls perspective.


As the integration work will go down over time, the role is expected to take broader BA wide responsibilities e.g. under the common Sandvik compliance program (and also locally for the Hub and our other local business).

title: Senior Director, Technical Business Consulting
description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

**Senior Director, Global Delivery Hub – Pune, India**
======================================================

Zendesk  



  

**Position Overview**
---------------------

Zendesk is seeking an experienced Senior Director to lead and develop the Global Delivery Hub based in Pune, India. This is a strategic leadership role responsible for driving the vision, execution, and growth of our consulting and staffing business operations in India. You will oversee end\-to\-end delivery excellence, manage key client relationships, lead a diverse team of talented professionals, and ensure our India operations support global business objectives while maintaining the highest standards of service delivery and client satisfaction.


This is an excellent opportunity to make a significant impact on Zendesk's global services strategy, shape the future of our delivery capabilities, and build and mentor a world\-class organization.  



  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Strategic Vision \& Business Leadership**

 Develop and execute the strategic vision and roadmap for the Zendesk Global Delivery Hub in India, aligned with overall business goals and growth initiatives


 Lead the entire India AI consulting, data migration and custom development teams, driving customer adoption, growth and operational excellence


 Partner with Global Services leadership team on strategic planning and execution to support global business requirements through India\-based delivery capabilities


 Enable cross\-region coordination between global clients and India delivery teams to ensure seamless service delivery  



  

### **Client \& Stakeholder Management**

 Manage key client relationships and serve as the primary executive stakeholder for major accounts


 Oversee multiple project delivery teams to ensure client satisfaction for customer engagements


 Drive client satisfaction, retention, and account growth initiatives


 Maintain focus on understanding client needs and driving continuous improvements in service delivery  



  

### **Delivery Operations \& Quality**

 Oversee end\-to\-end consulting and staffing delivery operations


 Ensure delivery quality, productivity, and fulfillment metrics meet or exceed established targets


 Establish effective governance structures, processes, and performance metrics to ensure efficient, cost\-effective operations aligned with global customer priorities


 Identify and implement continuous improvement initiatives to enhance capabilities, productivity, and service delivery  



  

### **Organizational Leadership \& Development**

 Lead and develop the Global delivery organization in India, including recruiting, delivery, and operations teams


 Oversee hiring, performance management, KPIs, and organizational planning


 Build engaged, productive teams that collaborate effectively across roles, departments, locations, and external partners


 Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and employee development


 Energize and inspire people through empowerment, recognition, and passion  



  

### **Operational Excellence \& Scalability**

 Develop and optimize operational processes to enable scalability and growth


 Collaborate with Finance, HR, Compliance, Recruiting, and Operations to drive organizational effectiveness


 Mitigate risk and solve complex problems through innovative and out\-of\-the\-box thinking


 Manage continuity, change, and transition effectively in a dynamic environment  



  

### **Leadership \& Culture**

 Embody and model Zendesk values, mission, and vision


 Demonstrate integrity, develop people, and build high\-performing teams


 Drive organizational change and influence others toward shared goals


 Address the impact of attitude and action on the organization and its participants  



  

**Required Qualifications \& Experience**
-----------------------------------------

 15\+ years of progressive leadership experience in consulting, services delivery, staffing, or professional services organizations


 10\+ years of senior leadership experience managing P\&L, large teams, and complex operations at a regional or global scale


 Proven track record of building and scaling high\-performing organizations from the ground up


 Demonstrated success driving revenue growth, profitability, and operational efficiency


 Experience managing key strategic client relationships and driving client satisfaction and retention


 Experience operating successfully in matrix organization structures


 Strong background in recruiting, talent development, and performance management


 Experience implementing operational improvements and continuous optimization initiatives


 Knowledge of India market dynamics and experience operating India\-based delivery centers highly preferred


 Experience in AI, technology services, or customer\-centric delivery models preferred


 Bachelor's degree required; MBA or equivalent advanced business qualification preferred  



  

**Core Competencies**
---------------------

  

### **Customer Focus**

Strives for customer success and exceeds expectations by understanding client needs and driving meaningful improvements in products and services. Takes a proactive approach to identifying opportunities to enhance the customer experience.  



  

### **Team Collaboration**

Builds engaged, productive teams while sharing knowledge and collaborating effectively across roles, departments, and locations. Extends collaboration externally with partners and customers. Creates an environment where diverse perspectives are valued and leveraged.  



  

### **Motivation \& Engagement**

Energizes and inspires teams through empowerment, recognition, and genuine passion for excellence. Manages continuity, change, and transition with grace. Skillfully influences and enables others to achieve shared objectives. Understands the impact of attitude and action on organizational success.  



  

### **Leading Change**

Possesses the skills and implements the functions of a transformational leader. Shares and communicates the company's values, mission, and vision effectively. Consistently displays integrity, models desired behaviors, develops talent, and builds strong, cohesive teams. Navigates organizational change while maintaining team morale and performance.  



  

### **Innovation \& Problem\-Solving**

Mitigates risk and solves complex problems through innovative, out\-of\-the\-box thinking and creative problem\-solving approaches. Challenges conventional wisdom and drives continuous improvement.  



  

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

We are seeking a strategic, visionary leader with an entrepreneurial mindset who can build and scale an exceptional delivery organization in India. The ideal candidate will:


 Have a genuine passion for building world\-class organizations and developing talent


 Demonstrate a customer\-first mentality and commitment to exceeding client expectations


 Bring strategic thinking with strong execution capabilities


 Show comfort operating in ambiguity and driving results in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment


 Possess strong financial acumen and business judgment


 Display emotional intelligence and the ability to inspire diverse teams


 Be a strong communicator with excellent presentation skills for executive\-level audiences

title: Value Realization Manager
description:
**Who are we?**


Checkmarx is the leader in application security and ensures that enterprises worldwide can secure their application development from code to cloud. Our consolidated platform and services address the needs of enterprises by improving security and reducing TCO, while simultaneously building trust between AppSec, developers, and CISOs. At Checkmarx, we believe it’s not just about *finding risk but* *remediating* it across the entire application footprint and software supply chain with one seamless process for all relevant stakeholders.


We are honored to serve more than 1,800 customers, which includes 40 percent of all Fortune 100 companies, including Siemens, Airbus, Salesforce, Stellantis, Adidas, Wal\-Mart, and Sanofi.

**About the Role**


We're looking for a \*\*Value Realization Manager\*\* to join our Revenue Operations team. This is a newly created role focused on one clear mission: making sure the GTM technology we've invested in—Clari, Outreach, PG:AI, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and similar GTM platforms—actually delivers the business outcomes it was purchased for.


You'll sit at the intersection of RevOps, Sales Enablement, and Vendor Management. Rather than just administering tools, you'll own the \*value\* they generate: adoption, ROI, workflow efficiency, and measurable impact on pipeline and revenue. If you've spent time as a customer success manager on the vendor side of GTM tech and are ready to apply that customer success discipline internally, this role is built for you.

 **What You'll Do**

* Own the end\-to\-end value realization strategy for our core GTM tech stack (Clari, Outreach, PG:AI, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and call recorder tools such as Kaia or Clari Copilot)
* Define and track adoption metrics, usage benchmarks, and ROI models for each platform; report regularly to RevOps and Sales leadership
* Partner with Sales, Sales Enablement, Business Application, and IT teams to ensure tools are configured, integrated, and used the way they were intended
* Identify underutilized features or workflows and drive targeted enablement to close the gap
* Act as the internal "CSM" for each vendor relationship—running regular business reviews, escalating issues, and holding vendors accountable to their own value promises
* Build and maintain a value realization scorecard/dashboard that ties tool usage to pipeline, forecast accuracy, and rep productivity outcomes
* Lead onboarding and change management for new tool rollouts or major feature releases
* Gather qualitative and quantitative feedback from sales reps and managers to continuously improve stack ROI
* Serve as the primary point of contact for renewal and expansion conversations, providing usage data and value evidence to inform commercial decisions

  

Requirements:
  

* 3\+ years of experience in customer success, revenue operations, sales enablement, or a related GTM function
* Direct hands\-on experience with at least 2 of the following: Call Recorder Tool, Clari, Outreach, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator
* Strong communication and presentation skills—comfortable in front of sales reps, frontline managers, and executive leadership alike
* Strong analytical skills—comfortable building dashboards, interpreting usage data, and translating numbers into a business narrative
* Excellent stakeholder management skills; able to influence sales leaders and reps without direct authority

**Strongly Preferred:**

* Prior experience as a \*\*Customer Success Manager at Clari, Outreach, ZoomInfo, or LinkedIn—you know these tools from the vendor side and understand how to extract maximum value from them
* Familiarity with GTM tech stack architecture and how these tools integrate with each other and with Salesforce/HubSpot

100

India \- Pune
